constraints.description: Rust, Python, and TypeScript SDKs retain 1.0.0/MIT identities, real authorship, exact customer install names, locally inspectable package contents, and an honest release-readiness status.

validation.validation_method: Manifest inspection, package metadata/content listing, and exact documentation-name search

constraints.description: Focused tests, examples/type checks, package generation or content listing, generated docs, and streaming examples pass locally; Rust preserves and proves the complete internal-crates to runtime to SDK publication chain.

validation.validation_method: Language-specific local commands plus the observed pre-runtime cargo package negative control

constraints.description: The legacy routine CI workflow is retired, deployment workflows are untouched, repository Tier 0 and strict OpenSpec pass, and evidence reports only observed scoped results.

validation.validation_method: Workflow lint/search, scoped diff, Tier 0, strict OpenSpec, artifact schemas/references, and independent review

global_rules: Use the OpenSpec proposal, design, delta, and tasks as acceptance authority.
Do not publish packages, remove embedded Rust support, add manifest dependencies, or expand SDK behavior.
Keep routine verification local and preserve deployment-only GitHub Actions policy.
Report language/profile results separately and do not run phase Tier 2.
termination_conditions: Strict OpenSpec, artifact schemas/references/state, scoped local checks, and diff integrity pass.
Independent artifact critic and judge find no implementation or evidence blocker.
